**Finding: compliant (sits at the fallback).**

- **Responsive clause:** § 5(a) imposes monthly floor fees on us ("not less than $\_\_\_\_ per month" for Hosting and Support Services), echoed as the "minimum monthly fees" in the documentation/disputes clause (p0047). That is a minimum commitment, so the rule is engaged.
- **Why it clears the fallback:** the commitment is bounded by a 1-year term with successive one-year renewals and a 30-day non-renewal right (p0078); § 14 gives us an unconditional election to terminate, with services (and therefore the floor fees) ending the last day of the month following notice (p0079); and no shortfall penalty, liquidated damages or early-termination charge exists anywhere in the document, so there is nothing punitive to convert into a true-up.
- **Noted, not flagged:** the exit date can fall up to ~60 days out rather than a clean 30 days' notice, and reduction is only by exit rather than by scaling the commitment down.
- **Boundary calls:** the § 3(i) credit-report ordering obligation is triggered only when we choose to route a request through the Interface and § 2(a) expressly preserves our freedom to use alternatives, so it is not a purchase commitment; the storage/bandwidth figures in § 3(a)/(c) are service specifications, not penalised usage caps.

No redline proposed.
